Tuition: pages 1-3 give a general tuition table by ISEE income bands and area (US/TS/UE) with coefficients by citizenship, but a single quote does not state one lowest and one highest fee for this student (Morocco citizen, household abroad), so no tuition figure is taken. Applicant's channel: for non-EU applicants requiring a study visa, the page says to submit application through apply.unisi.it; admission.unisi.it/?p=1421 confirms "apply.unisi.it portal" as the application site, so 'it-university-direct' is used. Universitaly is only mentioned for the visa application ("Visa Application (Universitaly)"), not for the programme application, so it is not used.
